retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
ACCOUNT TAKEOVER

DESCRIPTION:
Account Takeover (ATO) occurs when attackers gain unauthorized control of legitimate user accounts through stolen credentials, phishing, malware, or session theft.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1078 | Valid Accounts

INDICATORS:
- Logins from unusual locations
- Password reset requests
- MFA changes
- Suspicious account activity

DETECTION RULES:
- Impossible travel logins
- MFA changes
- New device registrations

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- User accounts
- Cloud services
- Email systems
title: ACCOUNT TAKEOVER
